claims.subject: Rothkötter Unternehmensgruppe
claims.object: around 4,500 employees, 7 production sites and €1.5bn revenue
claims.claim: Rothkötter reports around 4,500 employees at seven production sites in northern Germany and approximately €1.5 billion in revenue.
claims.boundary: These scale indicators do not quantify animal throughput, welfare outcomes or profit.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer company or authoritative disclosure materially changes these figures.

claims.subject: Rothkötter Unternehmensgruppe
claims.object: 3 feed mills, Emsland hatchery and 2 chicken-processing operations
claims.claim: Rothkötter states that the group includes feed mills in Meppen, Haren and Boizenburg, the Emsland hatchery in Dohren and chicken-processing operations Emsland Frischgeflügel in Haren and Celler Land Frischgeflügel in Wietze.
claims.boundary: A group operation list does not by itself resolve exact legal ownership, capacities or farm-to-facility flows.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official site record materially changes the operation list.

claims.subject: Landgeflügel
claims.object: sales and logistics of Rothkötter fresh and frozen chicken products
claims.claim: Rothkötter identifies Landgeflügel as the sales company responsible for distribution and logistics of the group's fresh and frozen chicken products.
claims.boundary: This does not establish a named retailer, customer or product-batch route.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes Landgeflügel's role.

claims.subject: Rothkötter feed mills
claims.object: pig and chicken feed for breeding and finishing
claims.claim: Rothkötter states that its feed mills specialize in producing pig and chicken feed for breeding and finishing.
claims.boundary: Feed production does not prove which farm or flock received a particular batch or that all feed in the poultry chain came from these mills.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the feed mills' product scope.

claims.subject: Rothkötter / Landgeflügel poultry chain
claims.object: from hatching egg and feed to finished chicken product
claims.claim: Rothkötter's Landgeflügel materials state that the group covers the value chain from hatching egg and feed through to the finished chicken meat product.
claims.boundary: A group-level integrated-chain statement does not prove that every animal passes through every group stage or identify a named farm-to-site path.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the described value-chain coverage.

claims.subject: Landgeflügel
claims.object: food retail, processing industry, wholesale and pet food
claims.claim: Landgeflügel states that it produces fresh chicken products for food retail, the processing industry, wholesale and pet-food channels.
claims.boundary: Broad channel coverage does not prove a relationship with any named customer or retailer.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the stated customer channels.
